The trends suggest the system might be approaching a tipping point - decreasing ac1, decreasing low_freq_power are classic early warning signals.

- 8.71% near tipping, 70.65% far from tipping

The query seems somewhat distant from the pool (median distance 0.7284), but all windows are within the reference range.

- "random" would be a uniform sample
